headline: AI Boom Drives Manhattan Office Market Toward Strongest Year Since 2000
summary: The artificial intelligence boom is helping lift Manhattan's office market toward its strongest year since 2000, creating tight real estate conditions for companies seeking space.
why: Real estate demand from technology sectors can significantly impact commercial property valuations, leasing volumes, and rental yields in major metropolitan business districts.

impacts.name: Commercial Real Estate
impacts.why: Increased demand from AI companies is lifting the Manhattan office market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
